attribute.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

attribute.sentenceEn: Some experts attribute the stress-reducing, health-related benefits of hugging to the release of oxytocin, often called "the bonding hormone" because it promotes attachment in relationships, including that between mothers and their newborn babies.
attribute.translationZh: 一些专家将拥抱带来的减压和健康益处归因于催产素的释放。催产素常被称为' bonding hormone '，因为它能促进人际关系中的依恋感，包括母亲与其新生婴儿之间的依恋。
attribute.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

attribute.sentenceEn: The correlation between happiness and investment was particularly strong for younger firms, which the authors attribute to "less codified decision making process" and the possible presence of "younger and less experienced managers who are more likely to be influenced by sentiment."
attribute.translationZh: 幸福感与投资之间的关联性在年轻企业中尤为显著，作者将此归因于这些企业“决策流程不够规范化”，并且可能存在“更年轻、经验不足的管理者，他们更容易受到情绪的影响”。
attribute.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

attribute.sentenceEn: He was searching for tiny engraved seals attributed to the ancient Mycenaean culture that dominated Greece from the 1400s to 1200s BC.
attribute.translationZh: 他在寻找一些刻有图案的小印章，这些印章被认为属于公元前14世纪至12世纪统治希腊的古迈锡尼文明。

attribute.sentenceEn: Over time, the attributes of greatness shifted.
attribute.translationZh: 随着时间的推移，伟大的特质也在不断变化。
attribute.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

automatic.sentenceEn: The review recommends a national branding campaign to give libraries a stronger physical presence, the reintroduction of a scheme to enable members to use their card in any library in the country, and automatic memberships for children.
automatic.translationZh: 该审查报告建议发起一项全国性的品牌宣传活动，以增强图书馆的实体感；重新推行一项让会员持卡即可使用全国任一图书馆的计划；以及为儿童自动办理入会手续。
automatic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

automatic.sentenceEn: Automatic doors often open to the side, with the panels sliding across one another.
automatic.translationZh: 自动门通常向侧面开启，门片相互滑动。
automatic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

automatic.sentenceEn: Without the need to be touched to open or close, automatic doors are essential in improving disabled access to buildings and helping provide general convenience to commercial buildings.
automatic.translationZh: 自动门无需手动触碰即可开关，对于改善残障人士的建筑物出入条件以及为商业建筑提供普遍便利至关重要。
automatic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

automatic.sentenceEn: Each automatic door system analyses the light, sound, weight or movement in its vicinity as a signal to open.
automatic.translationZh: 每个自动门系统都会分析其附近的光线、声音、重量或移动情况，并将这些作为开门信号。
automatic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

automatic.sentenceEn: There are many different types of automatic door, with each relying on specific signals to tell them when to open.
automatic.translationZh: 自动门有许多不同类型，每种类型都依靠特定信号来判断何时开启。
automatic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

automatic.sentenceEn: "It's as if you're driving a stick shift," says Judith Hall, a psychologist at Northeastern University, "and if you start thinking about it too much, you can't remember what you're doing. But if you go on automatic pilot, you're fine. Much of our social life is like that."
automatic.translationZh: 美国东北大学心理学家朱迪思·霍尔说：“这就好比你在开手动挡汽车，如果你开始想得太多，反而会忘了自己在做什么。但如果你进入自动驾驶状态，就会开得很顺畅。我们的社交生活大多也是如此。”
automatic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

abandon.sentenceEn: The most successful monarchies strive to abandon or hide their old aristocratic ways.
abandon.translationZh: 最成功的君主制国家都在努力摒弃或隐藏其旧有的贵族做派。
abandon.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

abandon.sentenceEn: "I don't know if other clients are going to abandon me, too," she says.
abandon.translationZh: 她说：“我不知道其他客户是否也会抛弃我。”
abandon.paperLabel: 考研英语 2004 英语（未分卷）
abandon.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第8句

abandon.sentenceEn: I have discovered, as perhaps Kelsey will after her much-publicized resignation from the editorship of She after a build-up of stress, that abandoning the doctrine of "juggling your life", and making the alternative move into "downshifting" brings with it far greater rewards than financial success and social status.
abandon.translationZh: 我发现，放弃那种“忙碌人生”的信条，转而选择“放慢生活节奏”，所带来的回报远比经济成功和社会地位更为丰厚。或许，凯尔西在不堪重负、高调辞去《她》杂志主编一职后也会有这样的感悟。
abandon.paperLabel: 考研英语 2001 英语（未分卷）
abandon.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

abandon.sentenceEn: A lateral move that hurt my pride and blocked my professional progress prompted me to abandon my relatively high profile career although, in the manner of a disgraced government minister, I covered my exit by claiming "I wanted to spend more time with my family".
abandon.translationZh: 一次平级调动伤害了我的自尊，阻碍了我的职业发展，这促使我放弃了原本相当体面的职业生涯。不过，就像一位失势的政府部长那样，我用“我想多花些时间陪伴家人”的说辞来掩饰自己的离职。
abandon.paperLabel: 考研英语 2001 英语（未分卷）
abandon.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

abandon.sentenceEn: With economic growth has come centralization; fully 76 percent of Japan's 119 million citizens live in cities where community and the extended family have been abandoned in favor of isolated, two-generation households.
abandon.translationZh: 随着经济的发展，日本出现了集中化趋势；其1.19亿人口中，多达76%居住在城市。在这些城市里，社区和大家庭的观念已被摒弃，取而代之的是独居式的两代人小家庭。
abandon.paperLabel: 考研英语 2000 英语（未分卷）
abandon.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

abandon.translationZh: 保守党可能会放弃“计划外”建设。

absorb.sentenceEn: Helping forests flourish as valuable "carbon sinks" long into the future may require reducing their capacity to absorb carbon now.
absorb.translationZh: 要想让森林在未来长期作为宝贵的“碳汇”蓬勃发展，可能需要现在就降低它们的碳吸收能力。
absorb.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

absorb.sentenceEn: The climate change we are hastening could one day leave us with forests that emit more carbon than they absorb .
absorb.translationZh: 我们正在加速的气候变化，终有一天可能会使森林释放的碳超过其吸收的碳。
absorb.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

absorb.sentenceEn: Infants are wired to look at parents' faces to try to understand their world, and if those faces are blank and unresponsive – as they often are when absorbed in a device – it can be extremely disconcerting for the children.
absorb.translationZh: 婴儿天生就会通过观察父母的面部表情来尝试理解他们的世界，如果这些表情变得茫然且毫无反应——就像父母沉浸在电子设备中时经常出现的那样——这会让孩子感到极度不安。
absorb.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

absorb.sentenceEn: But this seems to be the irony of office speak: Everyone makes fun of it, but managers love it, companies depend on it, and regular people willingly absorb it.
absorb.translationZh: 但这似乎正是办公室用语的讽刺之处：人人都拿它开玩笑，但管理者却对它青睐有加，企业依赖它生存，普通人也心甘情愿地接受它。
absorb.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

absorb.sentenceEn: I never feel overwhelmed with the amount of information my brain absorbs .
absorb.translationZh: 我从未因大脑吸收的信息量而感到不知所措。
absorb.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

absorb.sentenceEn: Sharpening judgment by absorbing and reflecting on law is a desirable component of a journalist's intellectual preparation for his or her career.
absorb.translationZh: 通过理解和思考法律来提高判断力，是记者为其职业生涯进行知识准备的重要组成部分。
absorb.paperLabel: 考研英语 2007 英语（未分卷）
absorb.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

accelerate.sentenceEn: The use of this little-known practice has accelerated in recent years, as colleges continue to do their utmost to keep students in school (and paying tuition) and improve their graduation rates.
accelerate.translationZh: 近年来，这种鲜为人知的做法使用频率急剧上升，因为各大学持续竭尽全力留住学生（并让他们支付学费），同时提高毕业率。
accelerate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

accelerate.sentenceEn: Worse, the numbers are now falling at an accelerating rate.
accelerate.translationZh: 更糟糕的是，这一数字如今正以加速之势下降。
accelerate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第7句

accelerate.sentenceEn: "Figuring out a way to accelerate that transition would make sense for them," he said, "but if you discontinue it, you're going to have your most loyal customers really upset with you."
accelerate.translationZh: 他说：“对他们而言，设法加速这一转型是合理的，但如果直接停刊，你们的最忠实读者会非常不满。”
accelerate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

accelerate.sentenceEn: According to BT's futurologist, Ian Pearson, these are among the developments scheduled for the first few decades of the new millennium(a period of 1,000 years), when supercomputers will dramatically accelerate progress in all areas of life.
accelerate.translationZh: 英国电信的未来学家伊恩·皮尔森认为，这些都属于新千年（一段1000年的时期）最初几十年内计划实现的发展，届时超级计算机将极大地加速生活各个领域的进步。
accelerate.paperLabel: 考研英语 2001 英语（未分卷）
accelerate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

addition.sentenceEn: In addition , you need to be willing to stand up to scrutiny and criticism and be prepared to explain your innovation in different ways for various audiences.
addition.translationZh: 此外，你需要勇于接受审视和批评，并准备好以不同方式向不同受众解释你的创新。
addition.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

addition.sentenceEn: In addition to the entourage of scientists, the team also included artists: Painter Thomas Moran and photographer Jackson were charged with capturing this astounding natural beauty and sharing it with the world.
addition.translationZh: 除了随行的科学家团队外，这支考察队还包括艺术家：画家托马斯·莫兰和摄影师杰克逊的任务是捕捉这令人惊叹的自然美景并向世界展示。

addition.sentenceEn: There's just one thing you should try to keep at least some time for, in addition to your writing—and that's reading.
addition.translationZh: 除了写作之外，有一件事你应该尽量保留至少一些时间去做——那就是阅读。
addition.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

addition.sentenceEn: This will help to grow your internal network, in addition to being a nice break in the work day.
addition.translationZh: 这不仅能为你的工作日带来愉快的调剂，还有助于拓展你在公司内部的人脉网络。
addition.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第6句

addition.sentenceEn: But in addition to those trusted coworkers, you should expand your horizons and find out about all the people around you.
addition.translationZh: 但除了这些你信任的同事之外，你还应该拓展视野，去了解周围所有的人。
addition.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

addition.sentenceEn: In addition , new digital technologies have allowed more rapid trading of equities, quicker use of information, and thus shorter attention spans in financial markets.
addition.translationZh: 此外，新的数字技术使得股票交易更加迅速，信息利用更加快捷，从而导致金融市场中的关注周期变得更短。
addition.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

ancestor.sentenceEn: As a historian who's always searching for the text or the image that makes us re-evaluate the past, I've become preoccupied with looking for photographs that show our Victorian ancestors smiling (what better way to shatter the image of 19th-century prudery?).
ancestor.translationZh: 作为一名历史学家，我一直在寻找能让我们重新评价过去的文字或图像，如今我痴迷于搜寻那些展现维多利亚时代先祖们微笑的照片（还有什么比这更能打破19世纪拘谨刻板的形象呢？）。
ancestor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

ancestor.sentenceEn: When our ancestors were hunters and gatherers 10,000 years ago, they didn't have time to wonder much about anything besides finding food.
ancestor.translationZh: 一万年前，当我们的祖先还以狩猎和采集为生时，他们除了寻找食物外，没有太多时间去思考其他事情。
ancestor.paperLabel: 考研英语 2009 英语（未分卷）
ancestor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

ancestor.sentenceEn: When the competitive environment pushed our ancestors to achieve that potential, they could in turn afford more education.
ancestor.translationZh: 当竞争环境促使我们的先辈们发挥这种生产潜力时，他们便能相应地获得更多的教育机会。
ancestor.paperLabel: 考研英语 2009 英语（未分卷）
ancestor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

ancestor.sentenceEn: This DNA can reveal genetic information about only one or two ancestors , even though, for example, just three generations back people also have six other great-grandparents or, four generations back, 14 other great-great-grandparents.
ancestor.translationZh: 这种DNA只能揭示一两位祖先的遗传信息，尽管举例来说，仅上溯三代，每个人还有另外六位曾祖父母；上溯四代，则还有另外十四位高祖父母。
ancestor.paperLabel: 考研英语 2009 英语（未分卷）
ancestor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第5句

ancestor.sentenceEn: He notes that each individual has many ancestors – numbering in the hundreds just a few centuries back.
ancestor.translationZh: 他指出，每个人都有许多祖先——仅回溯几百年，祖先数量就多达数百位。
ancestor.paperLabel: 考研英语 2009 英语（未分卷）
ancestor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

ancestor.sentenceEn: They seemed mysterious to human ancestors .
ancestor.translationZh: 对于人类祖先而言，它们似乎显得十分神秘。

anxious.sentenceEn: The booming economy seems to have done little to assuage this underlying generational sense of anxious urgency, especially for those who have college debt.
anxious.translationZh: 尽管经济蓬勃发展，但似乎难以缓解这一代人内心深处的焦虑紧迫感，尤其是那些背负大学债务的年轻人。
anxious.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

anxious.sentenceEn: To the anxious travelers the sight of the American shore brought almost inexpressible relief.
anxious.translationZh: 对于焦虑不安的旅人们来说，望见美洲海岸的那一刻，心中涌起的宽慰几乎难以言表。
anxious.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

anxious.sentenceEn: Strangers are inherently unfamiliar to us, so we are more likely to feel anxious when communicating with them compared with our friends and acquaintances.
anxious.translationZh: 陌生人对我们来说本质上是陌生的，因此与朋友和熟人相比，我们与陌生人交流时更容易感到焦虑。
anxious.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

anxious.sentenceEn: Many of us are weighed down by the past or anxious about the future.
anxious.translationZh: 我们很多人都被过去所累，或对未来感到焦虑。
anxious.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

anxious.sentenceEn: Readers of Happy Money are clearly a privileged lot, anxious about fulfilment, not hunger.
anxious.translationZh: 《快乐金钱》的读者显然是一群特权阶层，他们忧虑的是如何实现自我价值，而非忍饥挨饿。
anxious.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

anxious.sentenceEn: Meanwhile, as the recession is looming large, people are getting anxious .
anxious.translationZh: 与此同时，随着经济衰退的阴影日益逼近，人们正变得焦虑不安。

assemble.sentenceEn: How the whole image is then assembled and perceived is still a mystery although it is the subject of current research.
assemble.translationZh: 尽管这是当前研究的主题，但大脑如何将这些信息整合并最终形成完整图像的感知过程仍然是一个未解之谜。
assemble.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第3句

assemble.sentenceEn: They can also learn geometry by assembling a bicycle.
assemble.translationZh: 学生们也可以通过组装自行车来学习几何学。
assemble.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

assemble.sentenceEn: At a worktable inside the transformer plant, young Jason Stenquist looks flustered by the copper coils he's trying to assemble and the arrival of two visitors.
assemble.translationZh: 在变压器厂内的一张工作台旁，年轻的杰森·斯坦奎斯特显得有些慌乱，他正试图组装铜线圈，此时两名访客又恰好到来。
assemble.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

assemble.sentenceEn: The heightened alert followed an emergency meeting with flu experts in Geneva that assembled after a sharp rise in cases in Australia, and rising numbers in Britain, Japan, Chile and elsewhere.
assemble.translationZh: 此次疫情预警级别提升是在日内瓦召开流感专家紧急会议之后做出的。此前，澳大利亚的病例数急剧增加，英国、日本、智利及其他地区的病例数也在不断攀升，专家们因此召开了会议。
assemble.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

assemble.sentenceEn: Dr. Kroo and his team modeled what would happen if three passenger jets departing from Los Angeles, San Francisco and Las Vegas were to assemble over Utah, assume an inverted V-formation, occasionally change places so all could have a turn in the most favourable positions, and proceed to London.
assemble.translationZh: 克鲁博士及其团队模拟了以下情景：三架分别从洛杉矶、旧金山和拉斯维加斯起飞的客机在犹他州上空集结，组成倒V形编队，偶尔交换位置以便所有飞机都能轮流占据最有利的位置，然后继续飞往伦敦。
assemble.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

assemble.sentenceEn: It makes no difference how you write, just so you do. Now that you have developed a topic into a tentative thesis, you can assemble your notes and begin to flesh out whatever outline you have made.
assemble.translationZh: 你采用何种方式写作并不重要，重要的是动手去写。既然你已经将一个主题发展成初步的论文观点，就可以整理笔记，开始充实你所拟定的任何提纲了。
assemble.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）

assistant.sentenceEn: High school students who have had a strong positive influence on their community through an extracurricular activity may impress a college and win a scholarship, says Erica Gwyn, a former math and science magnet program assistant at a public high school who is now executive director of the Kaleidoscope Careers Academy in Atlanta, a nonprofit organization.
assistant.translationZh: 亚特兰大非营利组织万花筒职业学院执行主任埃丽卡·格温表示，通过课外活动对社区产生重大积极影响的高中生可能会给大学留下深刻印象并获得奖学金。她曾是一所公立高中的数学和科学磁铁项目助理。
assistant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第13段，第1句

assistant.sentenceEn: Joana Lia Ferreira, an assistant professor of conservation and restoration at the NOVA School of Science and Technology, notes that archaeologists first defined the great material ages of human history—Stone Age, Iron Age, and so on—after examining artifacts in museums.
assistant.translationZh: 新里斯本大学科学与技术学院的文物保护与修复助理教授乔安娜·莉娅·费雷拉指出，考古学家正是在研究了博物馆中的文物后，才首次定义了人类历史上伟大的材料时代——如石器时代、铁器时代等等。
assistant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

assistant.sentenceEn: Now the researchers are probing the specific effects of teaching style, teaching assistants ' eating habits and students' video exposure.
assistant.translationZh: 目前，研究人员正在深入探究教学风格、助教饮食习惯以及学生观看视频情况所产生的具体影响。
assistant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

assistant.sentenceEn: Schwitzgebel suspects the greatest impact came from social influence—classmates or teaching assistants leading the discussions may have shared their own vegetarianism, showing it as achievable or more common.
assistant.translationZh: 施维茨格贝尔认为，影响主要来自社会层面——主持讨论的同学或助教可能分享了自己的素食主义生活方式，让大家觉得素食不仅可行，还相当普遍。
assistant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

assistant.sentenceEn: Srini Pillay, an assistant professor of psychiatry at Harvard Medical School, believes this counterintuitive link between downtime and productivity may be due to the way our brains operate.
assistant.translationZh: 哈佛医学院精神病学助理教授斯里尼·皮莱认为，这种休息时间与工作效率之间看似矛盾的联系可能与我们大脑的运作方式有关。
assistant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

assistant.sentenceEn: Students without experience can catch up after a few introductory courses, said Tom Cortina, the assistant dean at Carnegie Mellon's School of Computer Science.
assistant.translationZh: 卡内基梅隆大学计算机科学学院副院长汤姆·科尔蒂纳表示，没有经验的学生可以通过几门入门课程赶上进度。
assistant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

attend.sentenceEn: And the demand that rose in those societies for entry to higher education extended to groups and social classes that had not thought of attending a university before the war.
attend.translationZh: 并且，这些社会中兴起的接受高等教育的需求，延伸到了战前从未考虑过上大学的群体和社会阶层。
attend.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

attend.sentenceEn: But this was not always the case; before it was legally required for all children to attend school until a certain age, it was widely accepted that some were just not equipped by nature to pursue this kind of education.
attend.translationZh: 但情况并非一直如此；在法律要求所有儿童必须上学至一定年龄之前，人们普遍认为有些孩子天生就不具备接受这种教育的能力。
attend.paperLabel: 考研英语 1999 英语（未分卷）
attend.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

attend.sentenceEn: I've attended research conferences where a scientist has been asked what he thinks about the advisability of continuing a certain experiment.
attend.translationZh: 我曾参加过一些研究会议，会上有人问一位科学家，他认为继续某项实验是否可取。
attend.paperLabel: 考研英语 1999 英语（未分卷）
attend.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

attend.sentenceEn: It is not simply to raise everyone's job prospects that all children are legally required to attend school into their teens.
attend.translationZh: 法律要求所有儿童在青少年时期入学，其目的并不仅仅是为了提高每个人的就业前景。
attend.paperLabel: 考研英语 1999 英语（未分卷）
attend.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

absence.sentenceEn: Restrictions that keep highly polluting cars out of certain areas—city centres, "school streets", even individual roads—are a response to the absence of a larger effort to properly enforce existing regulations and require auto companies to bring their vehicles into compliance.
absence.translationZh: 限制高污染车辆进入特定区域——市中心、"学校街道"乃至个别路段——是对缺乏更大力度举措的一种回应，这些本应有的举措包括恰当执行现有法规，以及要求汽车公司使其车辆符合标准。
absence.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

absence.sentenceEn: In the absence of work, a society designed with other ends in mind could yield strikingly different circumstances for the future of labor and leisure.
absence.translationZh: 如果没有工作，一个为其他目标而设计的社会可能会为劳动和休闲的未来带来截然不同的情景。
absence.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

absence.sentenceEn: As the Chinese philosopher Chuang Tzu is reported to have said: "Happiness is the absence of striving for happiness."
absence.translationZh: 正如中国哲学家庄子所言：“幸福在于不刻意追求幸福。”
absence.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第3句

absence.sentenceEn: This same absence of moral purpose was wounding companies such as News International, she thought, making it more likely that it would lose its way as it had with widespread illegal telephone hacking.
absence.translationZh: 她认为，这种道德目标的缺失正损害着像新闻国际这样的公司，使其更有可能迷失方向，就像其在大规模非法电话窃听事件中那样。
absence.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

absence.sentenceEn: Driving her point home, she continued: "It's increasingly apparent that the absence of purpose, of a moral language within government, media or business could become one of the most dangerous goals for capitalism and freedom."
absence.translationZh: 为了进一步阐明自己的观点，她接着说道：“政府、媒体或企业内部缺乏目标感和道德语言，这很可能会成为资本主义和自由最危险的隐患之一，这一点日益明显。”
absence.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

absence.sentenceEn: We have no land ethic yet, but we have at least drawn nearer the point of admitting that birds should continue as a matter of intrinsic right, regardless of the presence or absence of economic advantage to us.
absence.translationZh: 我们尚未形成土地伦理，但至少已经更接近承认这样一种观点：鸟类作为一种固有权利应当继续生存，无论它们对我们是否具有经济价值。
absence.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

academy.sentenceEn: High school students who have had a strong positive influence on their community through an extracurricular activity may impress a college and win a scholarship, says Erica Gwyn, a former math and science magnet program assistant at a public high school who is now executive director of the Kaleidoscope Careers Academy in Atlanta, a nonprofit organization.
academy.translationZh: 亚特兰大非营利组织万花筒职业学院执行主任埃丽卡·格温表示，通过课外活动对社区产生重大积极影响的高中生可能会给大学留下深刻印象并获得奖学金。她曾是一所公立高中的数学和科学磁铁项目助理。
academy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第13段，第1句

academy.sentenceEn: That is what a study, published from the University of California and Yale University in the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences, has concluded.
academy.translationZh: 这是加州大学和耶鲁大学发表在《美国国家科学院院刊》上的一项研究得出的结论。
academy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

academy.sentenceEn: "The Heart of the Matter," the just-released report by the American Academy of Arts and Sciences (AAAS), deserves praise for affirming the importance of the humanities and social sciences to the prosperity and security of liberal democracy in America.
academy.translationZh: 美国艺术与科学院（AAAS）刚刚发布的报告《问题的核心》因其肯定人文与社会科学对美国自由民主的繁荣和安全的重要性而值得称赞。
academy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

academy.sentenceEn: In response, the American Academy formed the Commission on the Humanities and Social Sciences.
academy.translationZh: 作为回应，美国人文与科学院成立了人文与社会科学委员会。
academy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

academy.sentenceEn: Reform has been vigorously opposed, perhaps most notoriously in education, where charter schools, academies and merit pay all faced drawn-out battles.
academy.translationZh: 改革遭到了强烈反对，其中最引人注目的或许是在教育领域——特许学校、专科院校以及绩效工资制度都面临着旷日持久的斗争。
academy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

academy.sentenceEn: The president of the National Academy , Bruce Alberts, added this key point in the preface to the panel's report: "Science never has all the answers. But science does provide us with the best available guide to the future, and it is critical that our nation and the world base important policies on the best judgments that science can provide concerning the future consequences of present actions."
academy.translationZh: 美国国家科学院院长布鲁斯·艾伯茨在该小组报告的序言中补充了这一关键点：“科学从来不能提供所有答案。但科学确实为我们提供了现有最佳的未来指南，我们国家和全世界的重要政策必须基于科学对当前行动未来后果的最佳判断，这一点至关重要。”
academy.paperLabel: 考研英语 2005 英语（未分卷）
academy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

accessible.sentenceEn: We are living through a golden age of science writing, so lucid and accessible that even lay readers can relish the unpredictability of discovery.
accessible.translationZh: 我们正生活在科普写作的黄金时代，这些作品清晰易懂，即便是外行读者也能领略科学发现中那不可预知的魅力。

accessible.sentenceEn: This form of accessible science means that great minds are able to join the race to create and develop projects with the potential to change the world.
accessible.translationZh: 这种易于获取的科学形式意味着，众多杰出人才能够加入到创造和开发具有改变世界潜力的项目的行列中来。
accessible.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

accessible.sentenceEn: For AI to be successful, data needs to be accessible , but the use of personal data is becoming more regulated and the automated sharing of data is becoming more difficult.
accessible.translationZh: 要让人工智能取得成功，数据必须易于获取，然而个人数据的使用正受到越来越多的监管，数据的自动共享也变得愈发困难。
accessible.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

accessible.sentenceEn: All the experts we spoke with highly recommend walking because it's the easiest, most accessible form of exercise.
accessible.translationZh: 我们采访的所有专家都极力推荐步行，因为它是最简单、最容易开展的运动形式。
accessible.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第3句

accessible.sentenceEn: As the interaction between organism and environment has come to be understood, however, effects once assigned to states of mind, feelings, and traits are beginning to be traced to accessible conditions, and a technology of behavior may therefore become available.
accessible.translationZh: 然而，随着有机体与环境之间的相互作用逐渐为人们所理解，那些曾经被归因于心理状态、情感和性格特征的影响，正开始被追溯到可理解的条件，因此行为技术或许有望成为现实。
accessible.paperLabel: 考研英语 2002 英语（未分卷）
accessible.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第9句

accomplish.sentenceEn: On their own, taking our own bags to the grocery store or quitting plastic straws, for example, will accomplish little and require very little of us.
accomplish.translationZh: 例如，单靠自己带购物袋去杂货店或停用塑料吸管，收效甚微，对我们的要求也极低。
accomplish.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

accomplish.sentenceEn: Looking beyond the culture war logic of right or wrong means opening up the middle ground and understanding that managing immigration today requires multiple paths and multiple outcomes, including some that are not easy to accomplish legally in the existing system.
accomplish.translationZh: 超越移民问题中那种非对即错的文化战争逻辑，意味着我们需要开辟中间地带，并认识到当今的移民管理需要多种途径和多种结果，其中包括一些在现有制度下难以通过合法途径实现的方式。
accomplish.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

accomplish.sentenceEn: "Universal history, the history of what man has accomplished in this world, is at bottom the History of the Great Men who have worked here," wrote the Victorian sage Thomas Carlyle.
accomplish.translationZh: 维多利亚时代的哲人托马斯·卡莱尔曾写道：“世界通史，即人类在这个世界上所取得成就的历史，归根结底是那些曾在这里奋斗过的伟人的历史。”
accomplish.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

accomplish.sentenceEn: "The valuable examples which they furnish of the power of self-help, of patient purpose, resolute working, and steadfast integrity, issuing in the formation of truly noble and manly character, exhibit," wrote Smiles, "what it is in the power of each to accomplish for himself."
accomplish.translationZh: 斯迈尔斯写道：“他们身上所展现的宝贵榜样——自助的力量、坚定的意志、不懈的努力和始终如一的正直品格，最终铸就了真正高尚而有男子气概的人格——展示了每个人都有能力为自己成就一番事业。”
accomplish.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

accomplish.sentenceEn: In fact, instead of straining muscles to build them, as exercise does, laughter apparently accomplishes the opposite.
accomplish.translationZh: 事实上，运动通过拉伸肌肉来强健肌肉，而笑显然起到相反的作用。
accomplish.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

accomplish.sentenceEn: We're also giving our customers better channels versus picking up the phone to accomplish something beyond human scale.
accomplish.translationZh: 我们也在为客户提供更优质的渠道，让他们不必再通过打电话来完成那些超出人力范围的事情。

accounting.sentenceEn: European ministers instantly demanded that the International Accounting Standards Board (IASB) do likewise.
accounting.translationZh: 欧洲各国部长立即要求国际会计准则理事会(IASB)采取同样的做法。
accounting.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

accounting.sentenceEn: After a bruising encounter with Congress, America's Financial Accounting Standards Board (FASB) rushed through rule changes.
accounting.translationZh: 在与国会激烈交锋后，美国财务会计准则委员会（FASB）仓促通过了会计准则的修改。
accounting.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

accounting.sentenceEn: Behind the scenes, they have been taking aim at someone else: the accounting standard-setters.
accounting.translationZh: 但在幕后，他们却把矛头对准了另一个群体：会计准则制定者。
accounting.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

accounting.sentenceEn: Indeed, just as there is the concept of Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP), perhaps it is time for GASP, Generally Accepted Security Practices, suggested Eli Noam of New York's Columbia Business School.
accounting.translationZh: 纽约哥伦比亚大学商学院的伊莱·诺姆建议，事实上，正如存在公认会计原则（GAAP）这一概念一样，或许现在是时候建立公认安全惯例（GASP）了。
accounting.paperLabel: 考研英语 2007 英语（未分卷）
accounting.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

accounting.sentenceEn: Just as bosses and boards have finally sorted out their worst accounting and compliance troubles, and improved their feeble corporation governance, a new problem threatens to earn them – especially in America – the sort of nasty headlines that inevitably lead to heads rolling in the executive suite: data insecurity.
accounting.translationZh: 就在企业老板和董事会终于解决了最棘手的会计问题与合规困境，并改善了薄弱的公司治理之际，一个新的问题——数据不安全——却可能让他们（尤其是在美国）登上负面新闻头条，而这类新闻不可避免地会导致高管层有人丢官卸任。
accounting.paperLabel: 考研英语 2007 英语（未分卷）
accounting.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

accounting.sentenceEn: One accounting firm, BY, uses an AI system that helps review contracts during an audit. This process, along with employees reviewing the contracts, is faster and more accurate.
accounting.translationZh: 一家名为BY的会计师事务所使用人工智能系统在审计过程中协助审查合同。这种结合员工合同审查的流程速度更快、准确性更高。

adequate.sentenceEn: In some areas, high daytime temperatures alone might serve as an adequate trigger for alerts.
adequate.translationZh: 在某些地区，仅日间高温就可能足以触发警报。
adequate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

adequate.sentenceEn: No matter how you "enhance" enclosures, they do not allow for freedom, a natural diet or adequate exercise.
adequate.translationZh: 无论你如何“改善”圈养环境，它们都无法提供自由、自然饮食或充足的活动空间。
adequate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

adequate.sentenceEn: This is an adequate amount so long as it is aimed in the right direction.
adequate.translationZh: 只要资金用对了方向，这个数额其实已经足够。
adequate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

adequate.sentenceEn: Meanwhile, the theft of information about some 40 million credit-card accounts in America, disclosed on June 17th, overshadowed a hugely important decision a day earlier by America's Federal Trade Commission (FTC) that puts corporate America on notice that regulators will act if firms fail to provide adequate data security.
adequate.translationZh: 与此同时，6月17日披露的美国约4000万信用卡账户信息被盗事件，盖过了一天前美国联邦贸易委员会（FTC）一项极其重要的决定的风头——该决定向美国企业发出警告：如果公司未能提供足够的数据安全保障，监管机构将采取行动。
adequate.paperLabel: 考研英语 2007 英语（未分卷）
adequate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

adequate.sentenceEn: The latter may commit crimes for lack of adequate parental control.
adequate.translationZh: 后者犯罪可能是因为缺乏足够的父母管教。
adequate.paperLabel: 考研英语 2004 英语（未分卷）
adequate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

algorithm.sentenceEn: Free yourself from algorithms and choose—anything.
algorithm.translationZh: 摆脱算法束缚，随心选择——一切由你。

algorithm.sentenceEn: Combining human creativity and AI algorithms can lead to unique artistic outcomes that are beautiful to the human eye.
algorithm.translationZh: 人类创意与人工智能算法的结合，能够创造出符合人类审美且独特的艺术成果。
algorithm.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

algorithm.sentenceEn: AI algorithms can analyze facial features and skin conditions to provide personalized beauty recommendations.
algorithm.translationZh: AI 算法可以分析面部特征和皮肤状况，从而提供个性化的美容建议。
algorithm.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

algorithm.sentenceEn: Avoiding dangers posed by all those human drivers would require too many algorithms , she said.
algorithm.translationZh: 她说，要想规避所有这些人类驾驶员带来的危险，需要编写太多的算法。
algorithm.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

algorithm.sentenceEn: In 2016, researchers developed an algorithm to recognize suspicious citation patterns, including groups of authors that disproportionately cite one another and groups of journals that cite each other frequently to increase the impact factors of their publications.
algorithm.translationZh: 2016年，研究人员开发了一种算法来识别可疑的引用模式，包括作者群体间不成比例地相互引用，以及期刊群体间频繁相互引用以提高其出版物影响因子的行为。
algorithm.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

algorithm.sentenceEn: Algorithms used to simulate human interactions are creating many of these concerns, especially as no-one is quite sure what the outcomes of using AI to interact with customers will be.
algorithm.translationZh: 用于模拟人际互动的算法引发了诸多此类担忧，尤其是因为没有人能完全确定使用人工智能与客户互动会产生何种结果。
algorithm.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

alongside.sentenceEn: The rise of citizen science has grown alongside the rise of do-it-yourself biology laboratories around the world.
alongside.translationZh: 公民科学的兴起与全球范围内DIY生物实验室的增多相伴而行。
alongside.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

alongside.sentenceEn: The proposal is that it should sit alongside the existing city of culture title, which was held by Hull in 2017, and has been awarded to Coventry for 2021.
alongside.translationZh: 该提案建议，这一奖项应与现有的“文化之城”称号并行设立，赫尔市曾于2017年获得该称号，考文垂市则被授予2021年“文化之城”称号。
alongside.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

alongside.sentenceEn: Doubtless a piece of boiled beef can always be served up on Sunday alongside some steamed vegetables, without the Yorkshire pudding and no wine.
alongside.translationZh: 诚然，周日餐桌上总能摆上一块水煮牛肉，配上些清蒸蔬菜，没有约克郡布丁，也没有葡萄酒。
alongside.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

alongside.sentenceEn: We need progressive policies that shape collective action (and rein in polluting businesses), alongside engaged citizens pushing for change.
alongside.translationZh: 我们需要能够引导集体行动（并约束污染企业）的前瞻性政策，同时也需要积极参与的公民推动变革。
alongside.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第4句

alongside.sentenceEn: Vocational schools should do a better job of fostering problem-solving skills and helping students work alongside robots.
alongside.translationZh: 职业学校应当更好地培养学生的解决问题能力，并帮助他们学会与机器人协同工作。
alongside.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

alongside.sentenceEn: Alongside that, many countries are introducing English into the primary-school curriculum but British schoolchildren and students do not appear to be gaining greater encouragement to achieve fluency in other languages.
alongside.translationZh: 与此同时，许多国家正将英语纳入小学课程，然而英国学童和学生似乎并未获得更多鼓励去熟练掌握其他语言。
alongside.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

apparent.sentenceEn: Production has been slipping away from Hollywood since the 1950s, but the effects have never been more apparent than at present.
apparent.translationZh: 自20世纪50年代以来，影视制作便一直在流出好莱坞，但其影响从未像现在这样明显。
apparent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

apparent.sentenceEn: Other artists besides Rutkowski have been surprised by the apparent popularity of their work in text-to-image generators—and some are now fighting back.
apparent.translationZh: 除了鲁特科夫斯基之外，其他艺术家也对自己的作品在文本转图像生成器中意外走红感到惊讶——有些人现在开始反击了。
apparent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

apparent.sentenceEn: Driving her point home, she continued: "It's increasingly apparent that the absence of purpose, of a moral language within government, media or business could become one of the most dangerous goals for capitalism and freedom."
apparent.translationZh: 为了进一步阐明自己的观点，她接着说道：“政府、媒体或企业内部缺乏目标感和道德语言，这很可能会成为资本主义和自由最危险的隐患之一，这一点日益明显。”
apparent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

apparent.sentenceEn: It is this apparent transcendence of politics that explains monarchs' continuing popularity as heads of state.
apparent.translationZh: 正是这种对政治的明显超越性，解释了君主作为国家元首为何能持续受到欢迎。
apparent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

apparent.translationZh: 更多看似合理的举措接踵而至。
apparent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

apparent.sentenceEn: While it probably wasn't apparent at the time, much of this work is permeated by a spirit of romantic escapism that the likes of Wordsworth would have readily understood.
apparent.translationZh: 尽管这在当时可能并不明显，但这类作品大多洋溢着一种浪漫的逃避主义精神，像华兹华斯这样的诗人想必能轻易理解这种精神。
apparent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

appreciation.sentenceEn: It's important to note that while AI can enhance our appreciation of beauty, it should not replace the genuine human experience and the emotional connections we derive from seeing the beauty in each other.
appreciation.translationZh: 需要注意的是，虽然人工智能可以提升我们对美的欣赏，但它不应取代真实的人类体验，以及我们在彼此身上发现美时所产生的这种情感纽带。
appreciation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

appreciation.sentenceEn: Now utopia has grown unfashionable, as we have gained a deeper appreciation of the range of threats facing us, from asteroid strike to epidemic flu and to climate change.
appreciation.translationZh: 如今，乌托邦式的理想已不再流行，因为我们对面临的各种威胁有了更深刻的认识，从小行星撞击到流感大流行，再到气候变化。
appreciation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

appreciation.sentenceEn: This was the tradition which revolutionised our appreciation of the past.
appreciation.translationZh: 正是这一传统彻底改变了我们对过去的认知。
appreciation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

arouse.sentenceEn: But many middle-class occupations – trucking, financial advice, software engineering – have aroused their interest, or soon will.
arouse.translationZh: 但许多中产阶级职业——如货运、财务咨询、软件工程——已经引起了它们的兴趣，或者很快就会引起兴趣。
arouse.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

arouse.sentenceEn: It's no surprise that Jennifer Senior's insightful, provocative magazine cover story, "I love My Children, I Hate My Life," is arousing much chatter – nothing gets people talking like the suggestion that child rearing is anything less than a completely fulfilling, life-enriching experience.
arouse.translationZh: 詹妮弗·西尼尔那篇见解深刻又颇具争议的杂志封面文章《我爱我的孩子，我恨我的生活》引发热议不足为奇——没有什么比暗示育儿并非完全是一段令人满足、丰富人生的经历更能引起人们讨论的了。
arouse.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

arouse.sentenceEn: He helped popularize the idea that some diseases not previously thought to have a bacterial cause were actually infections, which aroused much controversy when it was first suggested.
arouse.translationZh: 他曾助力普及这样一种观点：某些先前不被认为由细菌引起的疾病实际上是感染性疾病。这一观点在首次提出时曾引发诸多争议。
arouse.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）
arouse.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

arrangement.sentenceEn: The residents help to look after the children, an arrangement akin to alloparenting.
arrangement.translationZh: 养老院的老人们帮忙照看孩子，这一安排类似于“异亲抚育”。
arrangement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

arrangement.sentenceEn: And firms pay staff less because firms carry the burden of the employment arrangement going wrong.
arrangement.translationZh: 而且企业会降低员工薪酬，因为企业要承担雇佣安排出现问题时的风险。
arrangement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第4句

arrangement.sentenceEn: In the 1960s and 1970s, European universities saw marked changes in their governance arrangements , with empowerment of junior faculty and to some degree of students as well.
arrangement.translationZh: 在20世纪60年代和70年代，欧洲大学的治理结构发生了显著变化，青年教师获得了更多权力，学生在一定程度上也得到了赋权。
arrangement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第6句

arrangement.sentenceEn: The commission was also to consider possible arrangements for the War and Navy Departments.
arrangement.translationZh: 该委员会还需考虑战争部和海军部的可能办公安排。

arrangement.sentenceEn: Further arrangements – and there may be many – between the NHS and DeepMind will be carefully scrutinised to ensure that all necessary permissions have been asked of patients and all unnecessary data has been cleaned.
arrangement.translationZh: 英国国民医疗服务体系(NHS)与深度思维公司(DeepMind)之间可能还会有更多后续合作安排，这些安排都将受到严格审查，以确保已获得患者的所有必要许可，并且所有无关数据都已被清除。
arrangement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

arrangement.sentenceEn: In most of the homeless gardens of New York City the actual cultivation of plants is unfeasible, yet even so the compositions often seem to represent attempts to call forth the spirit of plant and animal life, if only symbolically, through a clumplike arrangement of materials, an introduction of colors, small pools of water, and a frequent presence of petals or leaves as well as of stuffed animals.
arrangement.translationZh: 在纽约市大多数流浪者的花园中，实际培育植物是不现实的，但即便如此，这些花园的布局设计似乎常常试图唤醒动植物生命的精神——哪怕只是象征性地——通过材料的团块状排列、色彩的引入、小水池，以及频繁出现的花瓣、树叶和填充动物玩具。
arrangement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

assessment.sentenceEn: Attempts have been made to curb this tendency, for example, by trying to incorporate some measure of quality as well as quantity into the assessment of an applicant's papers.
assessment.translationZh: 人们已尝试遏制这种趋势，例如在评估申请者的论文时，既要考量数量，也要纳入质量衡量标准。
assessment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

assessment.sentenceEn: Using caregiver assessments and the children's self-observations, she rated each child's overall sympathy level and his or her tendency to feel negative emotions after moral transgressions.
assessment.translationZh: 她通过照料者的评估和孩子们的自我观察，对每个孩子的整体同情心水平以及在道德失范行为后产生负面情绪的倾向进行了评分。
assessment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

assessment.sentenceEn: Any fair-minded assessment of the dangers of the deal between Britain's National Health Service (NHS) and DeepMind must start by acknowledging that both sides mean well.
assessment.translationZh: 要对英国国民医疗服务体系(NHS)与深度思维公司(DeepMind)之间协议的风险做出公正评估，首先必须承认双方初衷都是好的。
assessment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

assessment.sentenceEn: Rather than just focusing on GDP, over 40 different sets of criteria from health, education and civil society engagement have been measured to get a more rounded assessment of how countries are performing.
assessment.translationZh: 该研究不再仅仅关注国内生产总值，而是衡量了来自健康、教育和公民社会参与等方面的40多组不同标准，以便更全面地评估各国的表现。
assessment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

assessment.sentenceEn: Other standardized tests, such as the Scholastic Assessment Test (SAT) and the Graduate Record Exam (GRE), capture the main aspects of IQ tests.
assessment.translationZh: 其他标准化测试，如学术评估测试（SAT）和研究生入学考试（GRE），也包含了智商测试的主要方面。
assessment.paperLabel: 考研英语 2007 英语（未分卷）
assessment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

assessment.sentenceEn: A small step has been taken in the direction of a national agency with the creation of the Canadian Co-ordinating Office for Health Technology Assessment , funded by Ottawa and the provinces.
assessment.translationZh: 随着加拿大卫生技术评估协调办公室的成立，在建立国家机构方面已经迈出了一小步，该办公室由渥太华和各省共同资助。
assessment.paperLabel: 考研英语 2005 英语（未分卷）
assessment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第1句

atmosphere.sentenceEn: How can we inform decision makers about the best ways to bring down carbon emissions if we can't track the amount of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere , where it's coming from and who's producing it?
atmosphere.translationZh: 如果我们无法追踪大气中的二氧化碳含量、其来源以及排放者，又怎能告知决策者降低碳排放的最佳方法呢？
atmosphere.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

atmosphere.sentenceEn: Resting in the Pacific Ocean, Mauna Kea's peak rises above the bulk of our planet's dense atmosphere , where conditions allow telescopes to obtain images of unsurpassed clarity.
atmosphere.translationZh: 莫纳克亚山矗立在太平洋中，其峰顶高耸于地球大部分浓密大气层之上，那里的条件使望远镜能够获得清晰度无与伦比的图像。
atmosphere.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

atmosphere.sentenceEn: These men wrote and published extensively, reaching both New World and Old World audiences, and giving New England an atmosphere of intellectual earnestness.
atmosphere.translationZh: 这些人著述颇丰且广为发表，其读者遍及新旧大陆，为新英格兰营造了一种求知笃学的氛围。
atmosphere.paperLabel: 考研英语 2009 英语（未分卷）
atmosphere.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

atmosphere.sentenceEn: People are absorbed into "a culture of consumption" launched by the 19th-century department stores that offered "vast arrays of goods in an elegant atmosphere . Instead of intimate shops catering to a knowledgeable elite," these were stores "anyone could enter, regardless of class or background. This turned shopping into a public and democratic act."
atmosphere.translationZh: 人们被19世纪百货商店所开创的“消费文化”所吸引。这些商店“在优雅的环境中提供琳琅满目的商品。与那些迎合知识精英的私密小店不同”，这些商店“任何人都可以进入，无论其社会阶层或背景如何。这使得购物成为一种公开且民主的行为。”
atmosphere.paperLabel: 考研英语 2006 英语（未分卷）
atmosphere.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

atmosphere.sentenceEn: The latest was a panel from the National Academy of Sciences, enlisted by the White House, to tell us that the Earth's atmosphere is definitely warming and that the problem is largely man-made.
atmosphere.translationZh: 最近的一次警示来自美国国家科学院的一个专家小组，该小组是应白宫要求成立的，其研究告诉我们，地球大气无疑正在变暖，而这一问题在很大程度上是人为造成的。
atmosphere.paperLabel: 考研英语 2005 英语（未分卷）
atmosphere.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

atmosphere.sentenceEn: If we are ever going to protect the atmosphere , it is crucial that those new plants be environmentally sound.
atmosphere.translationZh: 如果我们真的要保护大气层，那么这些新建的发电厂必须符合环保要求，这一点至关重要。
atmosphere.paperLabel: 考研英语 2005 英语（未分卷）
atmosphere.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第6句

availability.sentenceEn: It can catch someone's attention in a crowded room, "Eye contact and smile" can signal availability and confidence, a common-sense notion supported in studies by psychologist Monica Moore.
availability.translationZh: 在拥挤的房间里，眼神交流可以吸引他人的注意；而“眼神交流配合微笑”则能传递出乐于交往和自信的信号——心理学家莫妮卡·摩尔的研究也证实了这一常识性观点。
availability.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

availability.sentenceEn: But that message did not play well with many in Iowa, where wind turbines dot the fields and provide 36 percent of the state's electricity generation – and where tech giants like Microsoft are being attracted by the availability of clean energy to power their data centers.
availability.translationZh: 但这一说法在爱荷华州的许多人看来并不受欢迎，该州的田野上遍布风力涡轮机，这些涡轮机提供了全州36%的电力——而且像微软这样的科技巨头也正被这里充足的清洁能源所吸引，为其数据中心供电。
availability.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

availability.sentenceEn: This is apparently the reason McDonald's restricts the availability of its popular McRib – a marketing trick that has turned the pork sandwich into an object of obsession.
availability.translationZh: 这显然就是麦当劳限制其人气产品McRib（麦辣猪排堡）供应的原因——这一营销手段已将这款猪肉三明治变成了令人痴迷的对象。
availability.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

availability.sentenceEn: The widespread availability of such recordings has thus brought about a crisis in the institution of the traditional classical concert.
availability.translationZh: 这类唱片的广泛普及给传统古典音乐会这一机构带来了危机。
availability.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

availability.sentenceEn: Other identifiable causes of offensive acts include frustration or failure in school, the increased availability of drugs and alcohol, and the growing incidence of child abuse and child neglect.
availability.translationZh: 其他可确定的犯罪行为诱因包括：在学校遭遇挫折或学业失败、毒品和酒精的获取渠道增加，以及虐待和忽视儿童事件的发生率上升。
availability.paperLabel: 考研英语 2004 英语（未分卷）
availability.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句
